title: Three Nights and One Short Thermometer
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：wrist　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wrist 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the nurse ① held the wrist that no sufferer in the ward would have noted, and he said the holding was the whole of the night. The ② wrist, meaning the joint itself and not the thermometer, ran three nights and stayed unnoted in the book; a wrist, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ wrist in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it, and the ④ wrist at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A wrist, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the nurse said the noting is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the wrist was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the joint. The ⑥ wrist, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; wrist, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both a joint and a skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ wrist had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short thermometer. The ⑧ wrist of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in April, was one ward and three nights of noting; wrist, he said, is either the dose at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ wrist I remember is the joint noted in the report, which closed in 1970 and is still noted as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ wrist, my mother said in 1972, is the only joint that improves by being noted; every wrist, she said, is a skill that has agreed to look like a joint. She said the skill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 手腕（指病房里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 手腕（指那只手腕本身，与细细的体温计相对）
C. 固定搭配：hold the wrist 握这一只手腕
D. n. 手腕（指留给孩子们服的那一剂）
E. n. 手腕之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的手腕之事）
F. n. 手腕（指护理记录里写到、被记下的那一只）
G. n. 手腕、巧劲（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 巧劲（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: held the wrist that no sufferer in the ward would have noted
The wrist, meaning the joint itself and not the thermometer
the wrist at the far cupboard
the wrist was the whole of the matter
the wrist had become a line in a report
The wrist of the whole thing
A wrist, my mother said in 1972

answers.why: hold the wrist 意为“握这一只手腕”，1963 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病患肯记下的一只手腕做了一遍。
wrist 意为“手腕”，指那只手腕本身而不是细细的体温计，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记下。
wrist 意为“手腕”，指病房里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。
wrist 意为“手腕”，指最远那格药柜的留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
wrist 意为“手腕、巧劲”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这只巧劲就是那件事的全部。
wrist 意为“巧劲”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只手腕，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
wrist 意为“手腕”，指护理记录里写到、被记下的那一只，到 1968 年这一只成了护理记录里的一行。
wrist 意为“手腕之事”，护士四月写道，整件事的手腕之事是一处病房和三个夜晚的记下。
wrist 意为“手腕”，我记得的是护理记录里记下过的那一只，1970 年挺过了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一只。
wrist 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，手腕是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的手腕。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年那位护士握了病房里没有一位病患肯记下的一只手腕，他说这一遍才是那个夜晚的全部。（hold the wrist）
那只手腕，指的是那只手腕本身而不是细细的体温计，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记下。（wrist）
那处病房里每一只手腕旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。（wrist）
最远那格药柜那只手腕，指的是他们留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（wrist）
叔叔说这只巧劲就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那只手腕。（wrist）
1972 年母亲说，手腕是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的手腕。（wrist）

Every wrist in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it.
The wrist at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the wrist was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the joint.
